discussion.body: Temple of Mist. Seat: Bengenia, west isle. World aspect: weather, form, visibility, the right to remain unnamed. The veil is the point of the temple. It cannot be cleared. Priests keep mist standing so Nyxara cannot be looked at directly and so Bengenia is un-mappable by Constium surveyors. Sigil: Veil. Combat: miss chance, form-shift, party stealth. Civic: Pale Kingdom roads only work inside the fog logic; outsiders get lost on purpose. Failure / wipe: a major event (Velith overdraw or a forced clearing rite) collapses the region. Towns on the west isle become wrecks in standing fog. That is the FEAT-003 event. Travel later treats Bengenia as a hazard zone, not a hub. Relation to other temples: Mist smothers Fire and Light; Earth and Water still exist under it. Owner NPC: Archon Velith. Party link: Seris.
